text: Sometimes a still image is magical, but that doesn't always mean it animates well. In this test, we're using Runway's imagetovideo tool to bring the umbrella man to life. While the background and objects animate beautifully, you'll notice one thing, the face struggles. Even simple expressions like smiling or blinking don't quite translate. This is a great reminder. If you love a piece of art and want it to move, try it anyway. Some images work instantly, others don't. And that's okay. You might need to tweak the style, change your prompt, or even redesign the character entirely. Animation is about adaptation, and the magic often comes from those small
Changes. So, experiment freely. Your next frame might be the one that truly moves.
